title: Concurrent CROSS HEAD drift during exact-head validation
cause: Other authorized CROSS chats committed while this execution was validating fixed snapshots.
observed_sequence: then source/test changes advanced branch to 69c6adde by record time
impact: A passing exact-head run is valid only for its tested SHA/tree.
Evidence from 120dfaea cannot be relabeled as proof for 69c6adde.
Moving-head validation can be perpetually invalidated by concurrent source commits.
proven: Railway deployment aa8aa11b succeeded for 120dfaea exact source identity.
Railway 6ec39a8b accepted exact 3f250224 identity and executed fresh gates, but branch advanced while it was running.
GitHub Actions current push runs failed before executing steps; one inspected exact-head job returned an empty step list.
mitigation: Bind all evidence to SHA+tree+deployment ID.
Use immutable validation snapshot or stop concurrent writes for final 100% gate.
Record HEAD drift as a blocker rather than merging evidence across SHAs.
